conflicts.fact: Which lesson covers temperature and where the temperature experiment/data come from; lesson numbering of the factors
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 only demonstrates temperature qualitatively and Lessons 2-8 are said to investigate the factors; Lesson 2 does only room-temperature trials. Lesson 3 says concentration is done in Lesson 3 and refers to 'collision theory we used to explain temperature in Lesson 1', while Lesson 4 repeats the identical concentration experiment and says collision theory was 'used in Lesson 3'. Lesson 8 gallery cites a 'Rate vs. Temperature graph (Lesson 3 class data)' and thiosulfate times at four temperatures, but Lesson 3 is concentration and no lesson collects temperature data at four temperatures. Lesson 8 also says Rate vs Concentration is Lesson 4 data.

conflicts.fact: Concentration investigation duplicated with different procedural details and which reactant is varied/HCl volume
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3: 5 cm³ HCl added to 40 cm³ thiosulfate. Lesson 4: 10 ml HCl per trial and total 50 ml, with 0.1 mol/L HCl. Lesson 2 uses 50 mL thiosulfate and 5 mL of 1.0 mol/L HCl. Lesson 3 title and explanation refers to 'more concentrated acid' while experiment varies thiosulfate.

conflicts.fact: Catalysts and light taught in both Lesson 6 and Lesson 7, with different experiments, while Lesson 8 and the sequence treat them as separate lessons/factors
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 covers catalysts and light (liver/H2O2, 3% H2O2) as 'Factor 4'; Lesson 7 covers them again as 'the final rate factors' (MnO2, 20-vol H2O2). Lesson 5 DQB says catalysts/light are still to come, and Lesson 7 says 'five factors' with sequence ending at Lesson 8 whereas Lesson 8 says 'four rate factors' and omits light. Lesson 8 Station 5 cites Lesson 6 liver data.

conflicts.fact: Rate values for beakers from Lesson 1 data / what Lesson 1 actually timed
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says Beaker A cross disappears in 2-4 minutes and records times only roughly; Lesson 2 says learners label Beaker A rate ≈1/240 s⁻¹ and Beaker B ≈1/35 s⁻¹ as 'calculated from Lesson 1 data', and Lesson 2 'Observed' says learners repeat the experiment; Lesson 2 predict says Beaker A Kericho while the anchoring text says Nairobi highland. Minor mismatch: 4 min exactly versus 2-4 min range.
Lesson 1 labels cold tray as Kericho morning (also Nairobi highland); Lessons 2 uses Kericho; Lesson 7 uses Nairobi highland; warm is Mombasa in L1, L2 and Mombasa/Kisumu in L7.

conflicts.fact: Whether lesson 1 model sketch and when the cumulative particle model began
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 has learners make an initial particle model; Lesson 2 says it constructs an 'initial particle model'; Lesson 3 says begun in Lesson 1; Lesson 5 says begun in Lesson 3; Lesson 7 says since Lesson 2.
Lesson 7 has six groups of ~5 while Lesson 7 stations take 20 min each in what the 40-minute lesson plan can't fit; Lesson 6 says a 40-minute lesson, Lesson 5 says 80 minutes, Lesson 1 40 minutes.
